title: C SOS vector-driven accept/reject test: sign over AddrForKey(pubkey), assert transcript-address migration
description: Found during 3x codereview of b7z9.121.2 (kimi-k3 pass 2, finding 2). No C test exercises the sos_post origin-address path end-to-end: coap_config_put_auth stubs the derivation (main.c:157-163) and sos_origin_verify, so nothing pins a key, signs over AddrForKey(pubkey), POSTs /sos, and expects acceptance; nothing asserts a signature over the legacy {0x02}+iid transcript is rejected (coap_server.c:505-509). sos_signature.json vectors are symbolic (no concrete crypto material), so they cannot catch a transcript-address regression. Needed: vector-driven accept/reject pair (accept = signature over AddrForKey transcript; reject = legacy-synthesized transcript) using a real pinned key + schnorr48 signer, ideally with golden signatures committed as a binary/hex fixture per test-vector discipline. Discovered-from project-LICHEN-worker6-b7z9.121.2.
